name: Catholic Timeline
description: Roman numerals II-XXX as regnal ordinals (Pius XII -> Pius the twelfth), with council/war exceptions first. Case-sensitive, whole words only. Abbreviations (St., Sts., Bl., Ven., Msgr., Fr., Mt.) are spelled out first. A rule may also carry kokoro_ipa: exact sounds in Kokoro's notation, used only by the Kokoro voice (its alias then just repeats the word).
